title: Viva Glint: import HRIS data through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing, administrator role and documented controls are supported. It distinguishes administrator-configured imports from the default-enabled Glint integration and reports the documentation's differences in connector naming, processing times and cloud coverage.

claims.quote: Customers will be able to use various connectors to HRIS tools to import HRIS data into Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service centrally imports and manages employee data for Microsoft 365 and Viva applications, including Viva Glint.
claims.quote: provides a centralized way to import and manage employee data for Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Viva experiences, including Viva Glint.

claims.claim: Workday is a supported employee-data connector.
claims.quote: Flexible employee data ingestion through multiple import methods, including Workday and SuccessFactors connectors, APIs, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and file-based imports.

claims.claim: SAP SuccessFactors is a supported employee-data connector.
claims.quote: SAP SuccessFactors Connector | Microsoft pulls data directly from SAP SuccessFactors's public APIs using SAP SuccessFactors credentials that you provide.

claims.claim: An API-based employee-data import method is documented.
claims.quote: [POST] https://orgdata.svc.cloud.microsoft/v1.0/dataUpload/HR/ingestions/fileIngestion?connectorId={connectorId}

claims.claim: The Glint import page names Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) as an import method.
claims.quote: Flexible employee data ingestion through multiple import methods, including Workday and SuccessFactors connectors, APIs, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and file-based imports.

claims.claim: CSV file upload is supported and is the Glint page's worked connector example.
claims.quote: Select a connector type. The following example uses CSV import.

claims.claim: Learn requires the Organizational Data Source Administrator role to create and manage employee-data imports.
claims.quote: To create and manage employee data imports in Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service, you must be assigned the Organizational Data Source Administrator role.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: Using this import route requires administrator configuration, so its default state is admin-opt-in and no import is forced.
claims.quote: The following steps describe how to create a data connection in Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service, configure access for Viva Glint, and import employee data. Before proceeding, ensure that Viva Glint onboarding has been completed

claims.claim: The Organizational Data Service integration is enabled by default for new Viva Glint customers.
claims.quote: For new customers, Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is enabled by default.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Existing customers with employee data in Glint must complete one-time attribute-mapping onboarding before Glint can import from the service.
claims.quote: Existing customers with employee data already configured in Viva Glint must complete a one-time onboarding process to map Organizational data attributes to Viva Glint attributes before Viva Glint can import employee data

claims.claim: Learn describes a phased release and says tenants without the onboarding banner do not yet have the feature.
claims.quote: Organizational data in Microsoft 365 is being released in phases. If you don't see the onboarding banner, the feature isn't available yet in your tenant.

claims.claim: Entitlement to the Glint import route is included under the consuming product's stated Viva Glint licensing requirement.
claims.quote: Licensing requirements vary based on the Microsoft 365 or Viva app that will consume organizational data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The get-started page requires a Microsoft Viva Glint license or a Microsoft 365 license that includes Viva Glint.
claims.quote: Viva Glint | A Microsoft Viva Glint license, or a Microsoft 365 license that includes Viva Glint

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The get-started page publishes no price or meter for the import itself at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Organizational Data Service licensing pricing import; read get-started in full, including licensing and connector requirements; also read import-orgdata, applications and import-org-data-api-call. No import price or meter stated.

claims.claim: The Glint switch is at Configuration > Service Configuration > General Settings > Technical configuration > Organizational data imports.
claims.quote: Select the Configuration symbol on your Viva Glint admin dashboard and then General Settings in the Service Configuration section. ... Technical Configuration ... Organizational data imports

claims.claim: Learn documents no API for changing the Viva Glint Organizational data imports switch.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Organizational data imports API PowerShell setting; Glint Organizational data imports PowerShell. Read manage-general-settings, modis-data-consumption and import-org-data-api-call; results document UI switching and data-upload APIs, not a switch API.

claims.claim: Completing onboarding automatically sets Organizational data imports to Yes.
claims.quote: After the onboarding process is completed, Viva Glint is configured to import employee data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service. The Organizational data imports setting is automatically set to Yes.

claims.claim: Disabled imports produce the ORG_UPLOAD_SWITCHED_OFF advisory.
claims.quote: When imports are disabled, Viva Glint stops importing employee data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service, and uploads return the ORG_UPLOAD_SWITCHED_OFF advisory.

claims.claim: Viva Glint is absent from the admin center's destination choices when Organizational data imports is disabled.
claims.quote: If Viva Glint doesn't appear as a option in the Choose apps and services page, it means that the Organizational Data imports feature is disabled in Viva Glint.

claims.claim: Entra role assignment is reached through Identity > Roles & admins > role > Add assignments.
claims.quote: Browse to Identity > Roles & admins. ... Select a role name to open the role. ... Select Add assignments and then select the users, groups, or agent identities you want to assign to this role.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments assigns a directory role through Microsoft Graph.
claims.quote: Use the Create unifiedRoleAssignment API to assign the role. ... POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments

claims.claim: The cited portal role-assignment steps require at least Privileged Role Administrator.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as at least a Privileged Role Administrator.

claims.claim: The Graph assignment request uses roleDefinitionId to identify the role.
claims.quote: "roleDefinitionId": "<ID of role definition>"

claims.claim: The Graph assignment request uses principalId to identify the assignee.
claims.quote: "principalId": "<Object ID of user or group>"

claims.claim: The printed Settings > Viva > Data management > Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service > Data connections > + New import > CSV import > Choose apps & services > Viva Glint > Choose attribute access route reaches attribute access.
claims.quote: Select Data connections, you may need to choose + New import. ... The following example uses CSV import. ... Choose apps & services ... Select the Viva Glint. ... Choose attribute access

claims.claim: Learn documents no API for configuring a connection's per-application attribute access.
claims.quote: Searched: Organizational Data Service attribute access API Graph; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph organizational attribute access Glint. Read applications, modis-data-import and import-org-data-api-call; api-changes search excerpt describes UI edits, not an access-setting API.

claims.claim: The printed Settings > Viva > Data management > Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service > Data connections > + New import > CSV import > Choose apps & services > Viva Glint > File upload, import method, and data staging > Data staging route reaches staging.
claims.quote: Select Data connections, you may need to choose + New import. ... CSV import. ... Choose apps & services ... Viva Glint. ... File upload, import method, and data staging ... When the data staging option is turned on

claims.claim: Learn documents no API for configuring data staging or approving staged imports.
claims.quote: Searched: Organizational Data Service staging API approval default; Organizational Data Service API configure attribute access data staging approval Viva Glint. Read review-quality-imported-data, modis-data-import and import-org-data-api-call; no staging-control API found.

claims.claim: Connection creation includes selecting the destination apps and services, including Viva Glint.
claims.quote: Choose apps & services ... Select the applications and services that should receive employee data from this connection. Select the Viva Glint.

claims.claim: Attribute mapping and attribute-access configuration precede validation.
claims.quote: 8. Map reserved attributes to your imported data ... 9. Choose attribute access ... 10. Review & confirm ... Select Begin validation to validate the connection configuration and imported data.

claims.claim: The administrator starts validation with Begin validation after reviewing the connection.
claims.quote: Select Begin validation to validate the connection configuration and imported data.

claims.claim: CSV imports default to incremental imports.
claims.quote: Incremental imports are selected by default, but administrators can choose a full import instead.

claims.claim: The CSV administrator can choose a full import instead of an incremental import.
claims.quote: CSV: The administrator manually selects a full or incremental import.

claims.claim: Imports support files up to 2 GB.
claims.quote: Connectors support imports up to 2 GB.

claims.claim: The Glint import page gives overall ingestion time as a few minutes to three hours.
claims.quote: Processing time varies based on file size and connector type. Overall ingestion can take from a few minutes to up to three hours.

claims.claim: The CSV service guide allows up to 24 hours for processing.
claims.quote: Validate and publish. Allow up to 24 hours to process (first upload can take up to 72 hours).

claims.claim: The CSV service guide allows up to 72 hours for the first upload.
claims.quote: Allow up to 24 hours to process (first upload can take up to 72 hours).

claims.claim: The CSV service guide allows up to three days for complete profile-store availability.
claims.quote: Validation takes a few hours; however, it can take up to three days for your complete data upload to be available in the profile store.

claims.claim: The get-started page labels the API-based connector Public Preview.
claims.quote: API-based Connector (Public Preview) | You send a .csv file from any HRIS source to the Microsoft API.

claims.claim: The other connectors in the get-started page's connector table carry no Public Preview label.
claims.quote: Searched: Organizational Data Service API configure attribute access data staging approval Viva Glint; opened get-started in full. Its table labels CSV Import, Workday Connector, SAP SuccessFactors Connector and Azure Blob Storage Connector without a preview designation.

claims.claim: The get-started page calls its Azure import option Azure Blob Storage Connector rather than the Glint page's ADLS name.
claims.quote: Azure Blob Storage Connector | Microsoft pulls your .csv file from Azure Blob using a Blob container URL you provide.

claims.claim: The get-started page says only Global Administrators and Organizational Data Source Administrators can upload data.
claims.quote: Only Global Administrators and Organizational Data Source Administrators can upload data.

claims.claim: The Glint import instructions say a Global Administrator assigns the Organizational Data Source Administrator role.
claims.quote: The Organizational Data Source Administrator role is assigned by a Global Administrator.

claims.claim: Viva Glint service administrators can also be assigned the Organizational Data Source Administrator role.
claims.quote: Viva Glint service administrators can also be assigned this role when they need to configure employee data imports through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.claim: The get-started workflow assigns schema mapping and enabling Organizational Data Imports to a Viva Glint Administrator coordinating with the HRIS owner.
claims.quote: Viva Glint Administrator | HRIS data owner | Complete Viva Glint schema mapping. Ensure imported attributes are mapped to the correct Viva Glint attributes. After configuration, enable Organizational Data Imports in General Settings > Technical Configuration.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Public reserved attributes are shared with Microsoft 365 Profile.
claims.quote: Public reserved attributes are shared with Profile and used by other Microsoft 365 experiences that consume Profile data

claims.claim: Profile-consuming experiences include Microsoft 365, Copilot, People card, Viva Amplify and Viva Engage.
claims.quote: including Microsoft 365, Copilot, People card, Viva Amplify, and Viva Engage.

claims.claim: Sharing of non-public reserved attributes follows the Organizational Data Source Administrator's chosen destination access.
claims.quote: Non-public reserved attributes can be shared with supported apps and Microsoft experiences based on the access chosen by the Organizational data source admin during connector setup.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Employee attributes imported into Glint can include names, manager information, hire date and office location.
claims.quote: The following public reserved attributes can be imported into Viva Glint: ... Microsoft_ManagerEmail ... Microsoft_FirstName ... Microsoft_LastName ... Microsoft_CompanyOfficeLocation ... Microsoft_HireDate

claims.claim: Glint imports only attributes shared with it through that connection's attribute-access configuration.
claims.quote: Viva Glint imports only the Organizational data attributes that are shared with Viva Glint through the attribute access configuration for this connection.

claims.claim: A custom attribute imports only when its Glint counterpart already exists with an exactly matching, case-sensitive name.
claims.quote: custom Organizational data attributes are imported only if a corresponding Viva Glint attribute already exists. The custom Organizational data attribute name must exactly match the Viva Glint attribute name, including letter casing.

claims.claim: Unmatched custom attributes are ignored.
claims.quote: If Viva Glint receives a custom Organizational data attribute that doesn't match an existing Viva Glint attribute, the attribute is ignored

claims.claim: Attribute access is configured separately per application and attribute, so Glint-specific selections do not change another application's selections.
claims.quote: Attribute access is configured separately for each application and service. ... For each attribute, select the applications and services that should receive the attribute data.

claims.claim: Attribute access is configured separately for reserved and custom attributes.
claims.quote: Attribute access is configured separately for reserved attributes and custom attributes.

claims.claim: Destination choices govern application-specific and custom attributes; public global attributes are automatically available to Profile and downstream applications.
claims.quote: For supported destinations such as Insights and Viva Glint, you can choose which custom and application-specific attributes are distributed to each app. ... These public organizational attributes are automatically available to Microsoft 365 Profile and the apps built on top of it

claims.where: controls[3].note; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Enabled staging prevents the upload from reaching Glint until an Organizational Data Source Administrator explicitly approves it.
claims.quote: When the data staging option is turned on, the uploaded file doesn't flow to Viva Glint until an Organizational Data Source Administrator explicitly approves it.

claims.claim: Data staging is available for all connectors.
claims.quote: Data staging is available for all connectors, so administrators can review the actual data before it flows to downstream applications and services.

claims.claim: Learn does not state that staging is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Searched: Organizational Data Service staging API approval default. Read modis-data-import, import-orgdata and review-quality-imported-data; they instruct administrators to select Turn on data staging and do not state it is on by default.

claims.claim: A full import replaces the imported employee population with the current import's contents.
claims.quote: Use full imports to replace the imported employee population with the contents of the current import.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Previously existing employees missing from a full import may become inactive depending on configuration.
claims.quote: Employees that previously existed in Viva Glint but aren't included in a full import may become inactive, depending on your configuration and import behavior.

claims.claim: Learn describes every Workday connector refresh as a full import.
claims.quote: Workday: Every refresh is a full import and sends a full-import signal to Viva Glint.

claims.claim: A Workday connector schema change automatically triggers a full import.
claims.quote: Any schema change for the Workday or SAP SuccessFactors connector automatically triggers a full import.

claims.claim: A SAP SuccessFactors connector schema change automatically triggers a full import.
claims.quote: Any schema change for the Workday or SAP SuccessFactors connector automatically triggers a full import.

claims.claim: After schema changes on other connector types, administrators must resend data for all employees.
claims.quote: For all other connector types, after a schema update, administrators must manually send data for all employees through a new incremental or full import.

claims.claim: Multiple connector instances or types disable automatic Workday and SAP SuccessFactors full imports to Glint.
claims.quote: If your organization has multiple instances of the same connector, or multiple different connectors, automatic full imports to Viva Glint through the Workday and SAP SuccessFactors connectors are turned off.

claims.claim: Each connector can send data to only one Viva Glint instance.
claims.quote: If your tenant has multiple Viva Glint instances, each connector can send data to only one Viva Glint instance.

claims.claim: Multiple connectors can import data into Viva Glint.
claims.quote: You can set up multiple connectors to import data into Viva Glint.

claims.claim: The Glint hierarchy mirrors Profile when derived from a Glint attribute mapped to Microsoft_ManagerEmail.
claims.quote: If the Viva Glint manager hierarchy is derived from a Viva Glint attribute that's mapped to Microsoft_ManagerEmail, the Viva Glint manager hierarchy mirrors the Profile hierarchy.

claims.claim: The consumption page instead names Microsoft_ManagerID in its advice for keeping the manager hierarchies distinct.
claims.quote: If you want to keep the Viva Glint Manager Hierarchy distinct from the Profile or Entra Manager Hierarchy then don't map Microsoft_ManagerID to Viva Glint's attribute used for Manager hierarchy derivation.

claims.claim: The import procedure requires completed Glint onboarding and enabled Organizational data imports.
claims.quote: Before proceeding, ensure that Viva Glint onboarding has been completed and that Organizational data imports are enabled in Viva Glint.

claims.claim: Glint's five required attributes are Email Address, First Name, Last Name, Status and Employee ID.
claims.quote: including the five required attributes: Email Address, First Name, Last Name, Status, and Employee ID.
